descriptionHtml:
WIE Unveil '24 was a transformative event held on 12th December 2024, aimed at introducing IEEE Women in Engineering and volunteering opportunities to the E21, E22, and E23 batches of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya.

The session featured inspiring keynote addresses by Prof. Maheshi Dissanayake and Dr. Akila Wijethunga, whose insights on leadership, innovation, and inclusivity left a lasting impression on participants. Their words motivated attendees to pursue impactful careers in STEM and emphasized the importance of volunteering and collaboration.

The event emphasized IEEE WIE's commitment to promoting women in engineering, driving innovation, and inspiring the next generation of STEM leaders. It provided participants with valuable opportunities to engage in mentorship, develop leadership skills, and explore pathways for career advancement.

WIE Unveil '24 truly showcased the spirit of collaboration and the potential of volunteering to shape a more inclusive and empowered future in engineering.
